stops.name: Prümer Burg Castle
stops.quote: From the keep of Prümer Burg on the steep cliff, you have a wonderful view over the Prüm Valley.
stops.english: From the keep of Prümer Burg on the steep cliff, you have a wonderful view over the Prüm Valley.

stops.name: Chapel of the Sorrowful Mother of God
stops.quote: The Chapel of the Sorrowful Mother of God (municipality of Dockendorf) is located on the circular hiking trail no. 89 of the Southern Eifel Nature Park.
stops.english: The Chapel of the Sorrowful Mother of God (municipality of Dockendorf) is located on the circular hiking trail no. 89 of the Southern Eifel Nature Park.

stops.name: Spangdahlem entombment group of Christ
stops.quote: In the chapel there are three sculpture groups: the Entombment group from 1643, the Lamentation, or "Holy Grave" group, and the Resurrection group created in 1750.
stops.english: In the chapel there are three sculpture groups: the Entombment group from 1643, the Lamentation, or "Holy Grave" group, and the Resurrection group created in 1750.

stops.name: Wikingerburg
stops.quote: The meter-high rampart of fallen stones is the remains of a millennia-old fortification on the edge of the Ferschweiler plateau.
stops.english: The meter-high rampart of fallen stones is the remains of a millennia-old fortification on the edge of the Ferschweiler plateau.

stops.name: Mindener-Layen
stops.quote: The old vineyard terraces in the Sûre Valley are a biotope and cultural monument particularly worthy of protection.
stops.english: The old vineyard terraces in the Sûre Valley are a biotope and cultural monument particularly worthy of protection.
